title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant

Warwick
£30,000
Monday to Friday, hybrid with three days in the office and two from home
Permanent

Our client is a long established and growing building services business based in Warwick, with much of its work now in the data centre sector. The office team is small, friendly and close knit, people tend to stay for many years, and everyone pulls together to help each other out.

Due to growth they are now looking for an Accounts Assistant to join the finance team. This is a new position and a varied one, covering purchase ledger, credit control and sales invoicing, along with general finance and office support. It would suit someone who enjoys being busy, takes pride in accurate work and likes being part of a team where everybody mucks in.

What s on offer
- Salary of £30,000
- Hybrid working, three days in the office and two from home
- Office days are 8:30am to 4:15pm, home days are 9:00am to 5:00pm
- 25 days holiday, increasing with length of service
- An extra half day off each month on top of your holiday
- Salary sacrifice pension, with employer contributions increasing with length of service
- Annual BUPA health assessment
- Death in service cover of five times salary
- Free parking on site

The role

Purchase ledger
- Enter purchase invoices and credit notes onto Sage, coding them accurately to the correct nominal codes
- Check and chase outstanding purchase orders each day
- Follow the approval process for purchases and keep records filed correctly
- Process supplier remittances every two weeks
- Make small payments by bank transfer and company credit card

Credit control
- Keep the debtor records up to date
- Contact customers by phone and email to keep on top of outstanding payments
- Help with enquiries coming into the accounts inbox

Sales invoicing
- Raise detailed sales invoices, starting with breakdown work and building up to other types of work
- Work with the operations team on invoice forecasting and job costing
- Maintain delivery note records
- Complete monthly reconciliations and invoicing linked to industry regulations

Office support
- Answer the phone and provide switchboard cover
- Open and distribute the post
- Keep filing and archiving up to date

About you

You will ideally have:
- Experience in an accounts role such as Accounts Assistant, Purchase Ledger Clerk, Finance Assistant or Credit Controller
- Experience of processing a good volume of purchase invoices
- Experience of Sage 50 Accounts or a similar accounts system
- The confidence to pick up the phone to customers about payments
- A working knowledge of Excel, including simple formulas
- Strong attention to detail and an organised approach
- A friendly, supportive nature and a willingness to help colleagues when the team is busy

Two lively dogs are in the office most days, and a cat visits now and then. You must be comfortable working around animals.

If this sounds like the right role for you, please apply with your CV today.

Brellis Recruitment is acting as an employment agency for this vacancy.

title: Commercial Property Paralegal
description:
Commercial Property Paralegal Warwickshire Salary DOE

A quality role, a supportive team and the opportunity to take real ownership of your work.

I'm working with a leading law firm looking to bring an experienced Commercial Property Paralegal into its team in Warwickshire.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys commercial property work and wants to be part of a firm that gets the balance right: high-quality work, genuine autonomy and a working environment where people feel supported and valued.

You'll have the opportunity to play an important role in the team, take ownership of your workload and work on a varied range of commercial property matters, with the support of experienced colleagues around you.

Importantly, this is a role where the emphasis is on doing good work in the right environment. If you're looking to move away from an overly pressured or volume-driven set-up and into a team that values quality, collaboration and a manageable workload, this could be well worth exploring.

What makes this opportunity stand out?
- Quality of work: Exposure to a varied caseload of commercial property matters, giving you the opportunity to build on your existing experience.
- Autonomy and ownership: The chance to take responsibility for your work, play an active role in transactions and make a genuine contribution to the team.
- A supportive culture: Work alongside approachable, experienced colleagues who value teamwork and provide support when you need it.
- A manageable workload: A more balanced approach, allowing you to focus on delivering quality work without the expectation of simply processing volume.
- Long-term development: An opportunity to continue building your commercial property expertise within a leading firm that offers a positive environment to grow.

Who would suit this role?

I'm keen to speak with experienced Commercial Property Paralegals who have a solid grounding in commercial property transactions, take pride in their work and are looking for a role where they can develop their expertise while enjoying the environment they work in.

You might already be happy in your current position but feel ready for a change of environment, or perhaps you're looking for greater responsibility and a team that offers the right level of support.

Either way, if quality of work, culture and work-life balance are important to you, this is an opportunity worth a conversation.

Location: Warwickshire

Salary: Dependent on experience

If you'd like to hear more, get in touch for a confidential discussion. I'd be happy to talk you through the opportunity and give you a better feel for the team and what the role could offer.

title: Customer Service Administrator - Deposit Specialist
description:
Job Description

Role - Customer Service Administrator (known locally as Property Manager: Deposit Specialist)
Salary - £25,000 per annum
Location - Olympus Ave, Royal Leamington Spa, Warwick CV34 6 RZ
Days & Hours - Mon - Fri, 9.00am - 5:30pm (1 hour lunch). Occasional Saturdays 9.00am - 1.00pm with Time Off in Lieu.

Employment Type - Full-time, permanent

Here at RA Bennett:Countrywide, we are looking for an ENERGETIC and ENTHUSIASTIC customer service specialist, who either has a background within property, or looking to embark within the industry.

Our Deposit Specialists play a pivotal role in ensuring that our landlord and tenant customers receive the high-quality experience they deserve, when coming to the end of their tenancy. So, we re on the lookout for people with great communication and relationship skills and a passion for delivering a quality customer service!

The Role:

As a Property Manager: Deposit Specialist, you will be fully managing your own portfolio of tenancies ending, across any of our 60 brands. Acting as a key contact for our tenants and landlords in the end of tenancy process, from the moment notice is given, through to the security deposit being released.

Providing a first-class service to our customers is at the heart of your role, and working in a fun and positive environment, your day-to-day duties may include:
- Arrange end-of-tenancy check-out appointments with landlord, tenant, and supplier, communicating appropriately
- Cross-checking original inventory against check-out report and identifying tenant liabilities
- Negotiate with landlord and tenants to agree deductions, within legislative timescales
- Identifying general maintenance or improvements to maintain the property in good order
- Work closely with our branch colleagues, expedite the process where there is a new tenant moving into the property
- Dealing promptly and courteously to communication with landlord, tenants, contractors, and internal partners
- Provide a first-class service to maximise customer retention and re-letting
- Work as a team player, being helpful and supportive to colleagues
- Ensure personal and team deadlines are met, service levels maintained and KPI's achieved

About You:

We're not just looking for good customer service; we re looking for Property Managers who can successfully negotiate agreements and adapt to the varying needs of our tenants and landlords and go that extra mile! Therefore you will need the following skills:-
- A positive 'can-do' approach is essential
- Passionate about delivering exceptional customer service
- Confident communicator, both verbal and written
- Effective negotiating skills
- Excellent organisational skills with attention to detail
- Strong time management skills
- Ability to problem solve
- Able to remain calm under pressure and work to timescales

What you get in return for a career as a Property Manager:
- 23 days annual leave increasing with length of service
- Pension scheme
- Full training, support and guidance
- Excellent career progression opportunities throughout the business
- Outstanding discounts across retail, entertainment, travel and health
- Wellness benefits

title: Customer Service Representative
description: Job title: Supply Chain - Customer Service Representative Location: Warwick Contract length: 6 months rolling contract (with long-term potential) Work Structure: Hybrid (2 days in the office) Randstad Sourceright, a leading provider of RPO & MSP Recruitment Services is currently recruiting for a Supply Chain - Customer Service Representative to join a World leader offering Products, Solutions and Services across the entire Mobility value chain on behalf of a well established manufacturing organisation to play a key role in supporting Manufacturing Operations. The Supply Chain Customer Service Representative serves as the key interface between international customers and internal operational functions, managing the end-to-end order lifecycle within the Aero Derivative Gas Turbine (AGT) product line. Key responsibilities include processing customer quotations, sales orders, and ERP transactions, alongside monitoring project milestones, investigating pricing structures, and ensuring strict compliance with operational customs and export control regulations. Acting as the primary point of contact, this role facilitates cross-departmental coordination across supply chain functions, leads customer-facing meetings, and resolves delivery issues under tight deadlines to maintain high service standards. Some of the duties will include but are not limited to: - Input and process customer quotations, sales orders, and associated documents into the company ERP system (SAP) within agreed target times. - Maintain accurate data entry and high attention to detail across all order records and customer files. - Act as the primary point of contact for global customers, communicating regular updates on order plans and progress. - Organize and chair customer meetings to review delivery timelines and maintain high customer service standards. - Resolve customer issues promptly or escalate critical problems within set company timescales. - Liaise with internal departments (procurement, logistics, operations, engineering) to ensure customer requirements are delivered on schedule. - Follow up on roadblocks across internal functions to avoid dispatch or manufacturing delays. - Apply and adhere to export control, customs compliance, and operational customs regulations for international shipments. - Monitor customer-specific trade rules, limitations, and regulatory requirements across global accounts. - Investigate underlying costs to help resolve customer pricing queries. - Prepare and update spreadsheets with cost and pricing data to support commercial decision-making. - Coordinate with line managers and system super users to identify training needs and maintain up-to-date knowledge. - Assist management with administrative duties and ad-hoc reporting as required. Essential Requirements: - Demonstrated working knowledge of the supply chain function, especially regarding customer interaction, quality standards, and overall business acumen. - Hands-on experience in order processing and customer service management. - Solid, clear understanding of operational customs controls, export controls, and customs compliance. - Familiarity with tracking and adhering to changing international regulations and specific customer-relationship trade limitations. - Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (particularly spreadsheet management in Excel for cost/pricing investigations). - Experience with ERP systems; hands-on capability in SAP is strongly desired. - High level of accuracy and keen attention to detail while working toward tight delivery deadlines. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a professional, well-organized approach. - Strong collaborative mindset with the ability to operate effectively within cross-functional teams and liaise with global customers. Desirable Requirements: - Direct hands-on experience using SAP is highly desirable for processing sales orders, quotations, and tracking transactions. - Degree qualification in a Supply Chain discipline is considered an advantage. - Background or familiarity within the energy sector, power generation, or industrial machinery (such as Aero Derivative Gas Turbines). - Previous experience managing global customer accounts and liaising with international cross-functional teams.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather relevant financial data and facilitate smooth communication across departments

- Excellent organizational skills with keen attention to detail and accuracy

title: PMO Coordinator & Document Controller
description:
Pontoon is an employment consultancy. We put expertise, energy, and enthusiasm into improving everyone's chance of being part of the workplace. We respect and appreciate people of all ethnicities, generations, religious beliefs, sexual orientations, gender identities, and more. We do this by showcasing their talents, skills, and unique experience in an inclusive environment that helps them thrive.

Job Title: PMO Coordinator & Document Controller

Location: Warwick / Hybrid

Contract Type: 6 months contract with scope to extend

Role Overview

This role sits within a major infrastructure transformation programme and is responsible for the control, governance, and secure handling of sensitive, confidential, and encrypted project documentation and information.

Working within a structured PMO and project controls environment, the Document Controller ensures that all programme information is correctly classified, securely managed, version-controlled, and fully auditable across the project lifecycle.

This role is critical to maintaining information integrity, compliance, and governance standards across all project documentation, including regulated and protectively marked materials.

Key Responsibilities

Secure Document Control & Governance
- Manage the full lifecycle of controlled and sensitive programme documentation
- Ensure all documents are correctly classified, versioned, and securely stored
- Maintain strict adherence to document control procedures for protectively marked / confidential information
- Control document distribution, access permissions, and encryption compliance
- Ensure traceability of all document changes and approvals

Information Management & PMO Support
- Maintain structured document repositories and controlled data environments (e.g. SharePoint / CDE platforms)
- Support PMO governance processes through accurate documentation control
- Maintain registers, logs, and information tracking systems (RAID, change logs, action trackers)
- Support audit readiness by ensuring all records are complete, consistent, and retrievable

Data Integrity & Quality Assurance
- Conduct routine quality checks on documentation and data records
- Identify and resolve inconsistencies in document versions, metadata, and classification
- Escalate data integrity or compliance risks to PMO leadership
- Support continuous improvement of document control processes

Secure Digital & BIM-Related Information Handling
- Coordinate secure submission, storage, and retrieval of digital project information
- Maintain controlled records relating to model/data submissions where applicable
- Track document/model status through review and approval workflows
- Ensure secure handling of digital outputs from design and engineering teams

(This is coordination and control-focused - not technical BIM production)

Stakeholder & Supplier Information Control
- Act as the primary point of contact for document control queries across project teams and suppliers
- Manage secure access requests and permissions for controlled systems
- Support onboarding/offboarding relating to information access rights
- Ensure external parties comply with programme information control standards

Skills & Experience

Essential
- Proven experience as a Document Controller in a project, programme, or infrastructure environment
- Strong understanding of secure document handling, confidentiality, and access control
- Experience working with controlled or sensitive information (e.g. protectively marked data)
- Strong knowledge of document management systems (SharePoint, Aconex, A-Site, or similar CDE platforms)
- High attention to detail and strong organisational discipline
- Experience maintaining version control, metadata standards, and audit trails

Desirable
- Experience in regulated sectors (utilities, defence, rail, energy, construction)
- Familiarity with ISO 19650 information management principles
- Exposure to BIM/digital engineering information workflows (administrative support only)
- Experience supporting audits or compliance reviews
- Experience handling encrypted or security-controlled documentation environments

Key Performance Indicators
- Accuracy and compliance of document classification and version control
- Timeliness of document processing and distribution
- Audit readiness of document repositories
- Reduction in document errors, duplication, or misclassification
- Compliance with secure information handling procedures

Apply now!

Please be advised: if you haven't heard from us within 48 hours, then unfortunately your application has not been successful on this occasion. We may, however, keep your details on file for any suitable future vacancies and contact you accordingly.

We use generative AI tools to support our candidate screening process. This helps us ensure a fair, consistent, and efficient experience for all applicants. Rest assured, all final decisions are made by our hiring team, and your application will be reviewed with care and attention.

title: Reception and Office Coordinator
description:
Reception and Office Coordinator

Warwick Permanent Full Time, 37.5 hours per week

Are you a Receptionist, Front of House Coordinator or Office Administrator looking for more variety, with an employer rated 'outstanding' by Best Companies?

Our client, a market leading international business in Warwick, is looking for a Reception and Office Coordinator to run their front of house and keep the office running smoothly. This is far more than a traditional receptionist job. You will be the first face people see at reception, and you will also support events, facilities, travel, fleet and office administration across the whole business.

What's in it for you
- Flexible working hours, with start times between 7am and 10am
- Bonus scheme
- Pension scheme
- Company share scheme
- The option to buy and sell holiday
- Generous staff discount on company products
- Rewards discount portal
- Yearly wellbeing calendar and dedicated mental health support advisers
- Long service awards
- Permanent role with an employer rated 'outstanding' by Best Companies

Hours

This is a 37.5 hour week. You can start any time between 7am and 10am, and core hours of 10am to 3pm must always be covered. As this is a front of house role, your hours will be guided by what is happening in the office. You will need to be in to welcome visitors, and on some days you will need to be around at the end of the day to reset the meeting rooms.

The role

As Reception and Office Coordinator you will manage all front of house activity and work as part of the facilities and compliance team.

Reception and front of house
- Welcome visitors and employees at reception, sign them in and out and issue badges
- Keep reception, meeting rooms and kitchens well presented
- Manage the post, phone lists and new starter details
- Order refreshments, stationery and office supplies
- Test the fire alarm, keep first aid kits stocked and monitor the security book

Meetings, visitors and events
- Book meeting rooms and arrange lunches
- Manage visitor parking, taxis and dinner reservations
- Provide administrative support for customer events held at the Warwick office

Office administration
- Manage purchase orders and invoices
- Enter customer details into the CRM system
- Send spares orders and flag low stock to Customer Support
- Provide office support to IT, quality, travel and fleet when needed

What you will need
- Experience as a Receptionist, Front of House Coordinator, Office Coordinator or Office Administrator
- A friendly, professional manner and a real willingness to help people
- Flexibility with your hours to fit around visitors, meetings and events
- Good organisation and attention to detail, with the discretion to handle confidential information
- Confidence with Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word and Excel
- 5 GCSEs or equivalent at grade C or above, including Maths and English

If you are a Receptionist, Office Coordinator or Administrator looking for a varied, permanent role in Warwick, apply today. Applications are being reviewed straight away.

title: Sales Ledger
description:
Sales Ledger & Credit Control Assistant
Salary: Up to £29 K
Location: Warwick
Hours: Full-time, Permanent and On-site

We're looking for a detail-oriented finance professional to join a busy and supportive finance team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience across sales ledger, credit control and reconciliations who enjoys taking ownership of processes and building strong relationships with customers and colleagues.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing the end-to-end sales ledger process
- Chasing outstanding debt and maintaining effective credit control procedures
- Allocating customer receipts and resolving payment discrepancies
- Processing and reconciling company credit card transactions
- Completing daily and monthly bank reconciliations
- Investigating aged debt and working with stakeholders to ensure prompt resolution
- Supporting month-end activities and finance reporting requirements
- Maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring data integrity

About You
- Previous experience in a Sales Ledger, Credit Control, Accounts Assistant or Finance Assistant role
- Strong bank reconciliation experience
- Confident managing customer accounts and credit control activities
- Good attention to detail and ability to work accurately under pressure
- Strong communication skills with a proactive approach to problem-solving
- Comfortable using finance systems and Microsoft Excel

What's on Offer
- Salary up to £29 K, permanent
- Stable and growing business environment
- Onsite Parking
- Immediate opportunity for interviews next week

If you're looking for a hands-on finance role where you can make an impact from day one, we'd love to hear from you.

Application Disclaimer: Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unfortunately unable to provide individual feedback to all applicants. If you have not heard from us within three weeks of submitting your application, please assume that your application has not been successful on this occasion.

Thank you for taking the time to apply.
